coach_rationale: 今天继续盯你最顽固的两处：过去式 -ed 结尾（suggested、returned、mixed、rolled、promised）和动词短语连读（picked up、mixed up、rolled out、put into、took out）。Mac 直读 EnglishPod365 笔记：自 10 月 16 日 EP0012 后仍无新内容，弱项仍是 10 月 12 日、16 日两集暴露的 fill me in、kicked me out、pick up a 这类连读短语，所以本篇把烤面包全流程的短语动词密度拉高，让你在慢速 TTS 里先把尾音和连读听清楚。另外提醒你：网站上次有分听写停在 10 月 22 日，今天这篇 B1 正好补一个新样本。
passage: Last Sunday, my wife suggested that we try baking bread at home, although neither of us had ever done it before. We watched a short video first, and the teacher explained that good bread needs strong flour, warm water, and a lot of patience. In the morning, we walked to the market and picked up flour, yeast, and a little salt. After we returned home, I mixed up the flour and water in a large bowl, and my wife added the yeast carefully. We waited for two hours while the dough rose slowly on the table. Then we rolled out the dough, shaped it into a round loaf, and put it into the oven. The kitchen smelled warm and sweet as the bread turned brown. When we took out the loaf, the crust crackled, and my daughter laughed because it looked like a small golden pillow. We cut it into thick slices and tasted it with butter and jam. Although the middle was a little soft, the bread tasted fresh and much better than the ones in the supermarket. We promised to bake again next weekend, and my daughter asked to shape the next loaf by herself.
